description_en: ACK cluster container security policies provide a rich set of built-in rule libraries, including Compliance, Infra, K8s-general, and PSP, to ensure the secure operation of containers in production environments. You can call the DescribePolicyDetails operation to query the details of a specified policy governance rule, such as the rule template description, governance action, and governance severity level
description_zh: ACK集群容器安全策略供了种类丰富的内置规则库，包括Compliance、Infra、K8s-general和PSP，旨在确保容器在生产环境中的安全运行。您可以调用DescribePolicyDetails接口，查询指定策略治理规则的详细信息，例如规则模板描述、规则治理动作、规则治理等级等
name: DescribePolicyDetails

parameters.help_en: The name of the policy governance rule
parameters.name: policy_name

action.description_en:
The governance action of the rule. Valid values:
`enforce`: blocks non-compliant deployments.
`inform`: generates alerts
action.description_zh:
规则治理动作，取值：
`enforce`：拦截违规部署
`inform`：告警
action.title_en: 规则治理动作 ● enforce: 拦截违规部署 ● inform：告警
action.title_zh: 规则治理动作 ● enforce: 拦截违规部署 ● inform：告警

description.description_en: The description of the rule template
description.example: Requires container images to begin with a repo string from a specified list

is_deleted.description_en:
Indicates whether the rule is deleted. Valid values:
0: The rule is not deleted.
1: The rule is deleted
is_deleted.description_zh:
是否删除标志，取值：
0：表示未删除。
1：表示删除
is_deleted.title_en: 软删除标志：0表示未删除 1表示删除
is_deleted.title_zh: 软删除标志：0表示未删除 1表示删除

name.description_en: The name of the policy governance rule

no_config.description_en:
Indicates whether policy configuration is required. Valid values: 
0: Parameter settings are required.
1: No parameter settings are required
no_config.description_zh:
是否需要配置策略，取值： 
0：表示需要参数配置
1：表示无需参数配置
no_config.title_en: 是否需要配置策略： 0表示需要参数配置 1表示无需参数配置
no_config.title_zh: 是否需要配置策略： 0表示需要参数配置 1表示无需参数配置

severity.description_en:
The governance severity level of the rule. Valid values:
`high`: high risk.
`medium`: medium risk.
`low`: low risk
severity.description_zh:
规则治理等级，取值：
`high`：高危
`medium`：中危
`low`：低危

template.description_en: The details of the rule template
